subject: Onboarding: tax routing for KKP Logistics (agent/broker) & PO activation plan
messages:

To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 14:12:00 +0200
Subject: Onboarding questions — tax residency & invoice routing for agent model

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the intro call earlier. As discussed, KKP operates as a logistics marketplace and we invoice Redwood as the onboarding broker for several EU-based sellers. A couple of points we need to clarify before we can populate our billing system and route POs: 

- Do you require a local fiscal representative (fiscal rep) for our NL entity or can we register under our existing NL VAT and supply a certificate?
- Because we act as an agent, we need to know whether Redwood wants invoices split (agent fee + seller settlement) or a single consolidated invoice from KKP. Which PO entity should the invoices target?
- What exact tax documentation do you need from KKP (vendor) vs. KKP’s sellers? We can share VAT certificates and a vendor tax sheet.

Attached: KKP_Tax_Sheet.xlsx (stub) and a sample VAT cert.

Goal: complete vendor profile and activate PO routing this week if possible.

Thanks — Ana
Ana Rodriguez
Head of Finance Operations, KKP Logistics
attachments: KKP_Tax_Sheet.xlsx, KKP_VAT_Certificate_sample.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Onboarding questions — tax residency & invoice routing for agent model

Hi Ana — great questions. TL;DR: we can support both split and consolidated flows but we need different evidence and PO routing depending on which you choose. Proposed plan below.

1) Vendor profile & tax evidence (required before PO activation):
   - KKP (vendor): current VAT registration extract / certificate for the EU entity + bank details (IBAN/BIC).
   - If KKP is acting as agent for third-party sellers and wants us to apply reverse-charge or notate supplier VAT separately, we need the sellers’ VAT certificates (or a signed tax residency attestation if out of scope).
   - For non-EU sellers, provide tax residency attestation or local withholding exemption docs.

2) PO entity selection (what your invoices should target):
   - Option A — Invoices to Redwood EU Services B.V. (NL) — use when services are supplied into EU and Redwood wants VAT accounted on our EU entity.
   - Option B — Invoices to Redwood UK Ltd. — use when seller services are UK-based (note UK VAT rules).
   - We prefer Option A for marketplace/agent flows where KKP is a pan-EU broker; Finance will map the NL PO to our NL ledger.

3) Invoice format & split guidance:
   - If you submit split invoices (agent fee + seller settlements), include a line-level reference for each seller with their VAT number and the associated seller VAT amount (if collected).
   - If consolidated, include an appendix (CSV) mapping settlement lines to seller VAT certificates. This lets us avoid manual reconciliation.

4) Timing & next steps:
   - Please send the VAT extract and bank details for KKP (attach to HubSpot record).
   - If you choose split invoicing, send one sample split invoice (PDF) so we can validate automated parsing.

I’ve looped in Laura for PO activation and entity selection. Karthik is cc’d to track the commercial impact.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Strategic GTM
Redwood Inference

Hi Ana — quick finance checklist and the PO activation requirements from our side.

Required invoice header fields for PO activation (example values in parentheses):
- Invoice number (INV-2026-123)
- Invoice date
- Vendor legal name (KKP Logistics B.V.)
- Vendor VAT number (NL123456789B01)
- Remit to entity: Redwood EU Services B.V. (KVK/EU tax id will be provided after PO activation)
- Purchase order number (PO-XXXXXX) — we will issue once your vendor profile is approved
- Line-level breakdown showing agent fee vs seller settlement when split

Banking / payment notes:
- Please provide IBAN + SWIFT with beneficiary as your legal vendor name.
- If you invoice in multiple currencies, indicate currency per line — Redwood will prefer EUR for NL POs.

Tax treatment notes:
- For EU-to-EU supplies where KKP has a valid VAT number and is the supplier of record, we will accept reverse-charge treatment provided seller VAT certificates are on file for the related settlement lines.
- If sellers are not VAT-registered, Redwood will apply the appropriate withholding or request corrective invoices.

Deliverables from KKP to unblock PO activation: 
- Completed vendor intake form (fillable PDF) — I’ll send the link after this thread.
- KKP VAT extract (PDF) and bank details (IBAN/SWIFT).
- One sample invoice (split if you plan to use split flow).

I’ve created a HubSpot record (see link Ben included). Once the attachments are uploaded we’ll run a quick validation (1–2 business days) and issue the PO.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations — Redwood Inference
attachments: example-invoice-split.pdf
